scripts.ios:build:local: export EXPO_NO_DOCTOR=1; export REPO_ROOT="$(cd ../.. && pwd)"; export OUT_MOBILE="$REPO_ROOT/out/mobile"; export EAS_CACHE_BASE="${EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_WORKDIR_BASE:-${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zollybot/eas-mobile}"; export EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_WORKDIR_BASE="$EAS_CACHE_BASE"; export EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_WORKINGDIR="$EAS_CACHE_BASE/run-$(date +%s)-$$"; export EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_TMPDIR="${EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_TMPDIR:-$EAS_CACHE_BASE/tmp}"; export TMPDIR="$EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_TMPDIR"; mkdir -p "$EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_WORKINGDIR" "$EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_TMPDIR" "$OUT_MOBILE/ios"; bunx eas-cli@latest build --platform ios --profile production --local --output "${EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_ARTIFACT:-$OUT_MOBILE/ios/zollybot-testflight.ipa}"
scripts.android:build:local: export EXPO_NO_DOCTOR=1; export REPO_ROOT="$(cd ../.. && pwd)"; export OUT_MOBILE="$REPO_ROOT/out/mobile"; export EAS_CACHE_BASE="${EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_WORKDIR_BASE:-${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zollybot/eas-mobile}"; export EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_WORKDIR_BASE="$EAS_CACHE_BASE"; export EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_WORKINGDIR="$EAS_CACHE_BASE/run-$(date +%s)-$$"; export EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_TMPDIR="${EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_TMPDIR:-$EAS_CACHE_BASE/tmp}"; export TMPDIR="$EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_TMPDIR"; mkdir -p "$EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_WORKINGDIR" "$EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_TMPDIR" "$OUT_MOBILE/android"; if [ -z "${ANDROID_HOME:-}" ] && [ -d "$HOME/.local/opt/android-re/sdk" ]; then export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/.local/opt/android-re/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; export PATH="$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$ANDROID_HOME/emulator:$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH"; fi; if [ -z "${ANDROID_NDK_HOME:-}" ]; then for dir in "${ANDROID_HOME:-}"/ndk/* "$HOME/.local/opt/android-re/sdk"/ndk/*; do if [ -f "$dir/source.properties" ]; then export ANDROID_NDK_HOME="$dir"; break; fi; done; fi; bunx eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile production --local --output "${EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_ARTIFACT:-$OUT_MOBILE/android/zollybot-play.aab}"
scripts.android:build:apk:local: export EXPO_NO_DOCTOR=1; export REPO_ROOT="$(cd ../.. && pwd)"; export OUT_MOBILE="$REPO_ROOT/out/mobile"; export EAS_CACHE_BASE="${EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_WORKDIR_BASE:-${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/zollybot/eas-mobile}"; export EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_WORKDIR_BASE="$EAS_CACHE_BASE"; export EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_WORKINGDIR="$EAS_CACHE_BASE/run-$(date +%s)-$$"; export EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_TMPDIR="${EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_TMPDIR:-$EAS_CACHE_BASE/tmp}"; export TMPDIR="$EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_TMPDIR"; mkdir -p "$EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_WORKINGDIR" "$EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_TMPDIR" "$OUT_MOBILE/android"; if [ -z "${ANDROID_HOME:-}" ] && [ -d "$HOME/.local/opt/android-re/sdk" ]; then export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/.local/opt/android-re/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; export PATH="$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$ANDROID_HOME/emulator:$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH"; fi; if [ -z "${ANDROID_NDK_HOME:-}" ]; then for dir in "${ANDROID_HOME:-}"/ndk/* "$HOME/.local/opt/android-re/sdk"/ndk/*; do if [ -f "$dir/source.properties" ]; then export ANDROID_NDK_HOME="$dir"; break; fi; done; fi; bunx eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile production-apk --local --output "${EAS_LOCAL_BUILD_ARTIFACT:-$OUT_MOBILE/android/zollybot.apk}"
